title: The Rebundling of Freelance Work in the AI Age
abstract: arXiv:2611.14708v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper examines how freelance work is changing in the AI era. We compare the activities people undertake in ChatGPT with the work clients request on Upwork, an online freelance platform, and examine how clients combine tasks into projects. We find that activities more prevalent in ChatGPT tend to lose marketplace share on Upwork, while those less prevalent tend to gain share. Within AI-related work, demand is becoming more diverse, and job postings combine tasks that were rarely requested together before the generative AI era. AI-related postings also have substantially larger project budgets and involve more hours of work, while differences in hourly rates are small. Together, these findings suggest that AI is reshaping not only which tasks clients outsource, but also how they combine tasks into larger, higher-value projects.

translated_title: AI时代自由职业工作的重新捆绑
translated_abstract: 本文研究了人工智能时代自由职业工作正在发生的变化。我们比较了人们在ChatGPT中从事的活动与客户在Upwork（一个在线自由职业平台）上所请求的工作，并考察了客户如何将任务组合成项目。我们发现，在ChatGPT中更常见的活动往往在Upwork上失去市场份额，而不太常见的活动则倾向于获得更多份额。在与AI相关的工作中，需求正变得更加多样化，职位发布将生成式AI时代之前很少被一起请求的任务组合在了一起。与AI相关的职位发布还具有大得多的项目预算，并涉及更多的工作时长，而小时费率的差异则较小。综合来看，这些发现表明，AI不仅重塑了客户外包哪些任务，还重塑了他们如何将任务组合成更大、更高价值的项目。
tldr: 该研究发现AI正在重塑自由职业市场的任务组合方式：ChatGPT中常见的活动在Upwork上失去份额，而AI相关需求更加多样化、项目预算更大且工时更长，表明AI不仅改变了客户外包的任务类型，还改变了将任务捆绑成更大、更高价值项目的方式。
